blind.description: A stone dungeon or cell bed comprising a carved grey stone slab base supported by two sturdy masonry block legs. On top rests a padded brown leather or fabric mattress tied down with pointed tufting tabs along the sides, accompanied by a rumpled, bunched brown blanket or fur pelt at one end. Surfaces are solid, low-poly stylized, and continuous with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A rectangular stone slab containing a long rectangular brown mattress with tufted tie points along the edges and a wrinkled brown blanket bundled at the bottom end.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 ft high (reaching below knee height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 6 ft long, and about 2.5 ft wide.

notes: gemini note: slightly taller than catalog proportions
